name: What is the process for getting a fence repair estimate from Maine Results, Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting a fence repair estimate from Maine Results, Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get a fence repair estimate from Maine Results, Inc., simply contact us to schedule an on-site assessment. A technician will visit your property in Garden City, Meridian, Eagle, or Kuna to inspect the damage, discuss your repair needs, and provide a detailed quote. This allows us to accurately assess the scope of work and materials required, ensuring a precise estimate with no hidden fees.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contact Maine Results, Inc. for an on-site assessment; a technician will inspect the damage and provide a detailed quote.
